stepNotes.1: The debug-engine facade exports nine graph/scanner/refactor features plus plan reads; correlation and prewarm have live bootstrap/diagnostics consumers, while language-scan and pattern-memory have no production importer.
stepNotes.2: Scanner file selection applies Instance.containsPath and tool schemas cap file/finding budgets; runtime evidence is capped at 200 KB, and refactor_apply requests edit permission before running project commands or applying a patch.
stepNotes.3: Bug analysis preserves cite-or-drop and impact truncation forces high risk, but impact traverses callers only and correlation assigns high confidence from cross-file topology without using the diagnostic message; both are Medium inference limitations.
stepNotes.4: Race and lifecycle function-scope detection starts only at brace depth zero, missing class methods in JavaScript mode; native security lacks the TypeScript trusted-script exemption and falsely marks exactly-at-cap collections truncated.
stepNotes.5: High finding: apply-safe-refactor uses one .dre-apply.patch path in the real worktree while ShadowWorktree permits three same-project operations, enabling patch-file races and collision with a tracked file of that name.
stepNotes.6: Budgets bound graph walks and caches are TTL/size limited, but the 10,000-candidate duplicate option can drive about 50 million event-loop Jaccard comparisons; pattern eviction is a soft check-before-insert cap.
stepNotes.7: DRE schemas, algorithms, and CRUD are separated coherently; dormant language/pattern slices, storePattern's empty-string error sentinel, unknown native finding payloads, and one as-any cast remain maintenance debt.
stepNotes.8: Twelve focused suites cover the major graph, scanner, persistence, correlation, native-envelope, runtime-schema, and apply branches; gaps include class fixtures, native parity, non-call impact, semantic-negative correlation, and concurrent apply.
stepNotes.9: All 12 focused files and 212 tests passed, and core tsgo typecheck passed; no Critical item or findings file exists, so the conditional reverify artifact was not emitted and ax-code-glm remains the independent verifier lane.
